overview.title: Roles
overview.description: Who each role is meant for.

roles.manager: For individual people who should be allowed more than users, but not everything. Applies across the whole organisation, unlike team admin.
roles.admin: For the people who look after Ayunis Core in your administration. Can do everything and cannot be restricted.
roles.teamAdmin: Appointed per team and keeps the rights of their role on top. What team admins may do in their own team is set below.

matrix.title: Permissions
matrix.description: Choose what users and managers are allowed to do. Admins always have every permission.

permissionHints.manage_teams: Create, rename and delete teams and appoint team admins in every team.
permissionHints.assign_users_to_teams: Add members to any team and remove them again. Does not allow creating or deleting teams.
permissionHints.manage_own_skills: Create, edit and delete your own skills, including their instructions, sources and integrations.
permissionHints.install_marketplace_skills: Add skills from the Ayunis Core Marketplace to your own skills. Without this permission, Marketplace hints and the menu item are hidden.
permissionHints.request_skill_transfer: Offer an own skill to a team one is a member of. Once approved it belongs to the team.
permissionHints.request_skill_transfer_other_teams: Also offer an own skill to teams one is not a member of. Their team admins review the request.
permissionHints.request_skill_transfer_org: Offer an own skill to the whole organisation. Once approved it belongs to the organisation.
permissionHints.review_all_skill_requests: Approve or reject requests to the organisation and to every team, even without being team admin there.
permissionHints.manage_own_knowledge: Create, edit and delete your own knowledge bases and the documents inside them.
permissionHints.request_knowledge_transfer: Offer an own knowledge base to a team one is a member of. Once approved it belongs to the team.
permissionHints.request_knowledge_transfer_other_teams: Also offer an own knowledge base to teams one is not a member of. Their team admins review the request.
permissionHints.request_knowledge_transfer_org: Offer an own knowledge base to the whole organisation. Once approved it belongs to the organisation.
permissionHints.review_all_knowledge_requests: Approve or reject requests to the organisation and to every team, even without being team admin there.
permissionHints.manage_org_skills: Create, edit and delete skills for everyone in the organisation.
permissionHints.manage_org_knowledge: Create, edit and delete knowledge bases for everyone in the organisation.

teamAdmins.title: Team admins
teamAdmins.description: Choose what team admins may do in their own team.
teamAdmins.note: Only admins can change or remove the last team admin of a team.

permissionHints.team_manage_members: Add people to their own team and remove them again.
permissionHints.team_appoint_admins: Make other members of their own team team admin or take the role away again.
permissionHints.team_manage_skills: Create, edit and delete the team's skills.
permissionHints.team_manage_knowledge: Create, edit and delete the team's knowledge bases.
permissionHints.team_review_requests: Approve or reject handovers to their own team.

minOnePermission: Each role must keep at least one permission
